title: The board's legend
direction: A×C · Round 8 · /the-lab · ledger that opens in place (LG)
summary: The status board read row by row: each instrument with what it reads and its stage in a four-segment gauge; open, what it would do beyond today's hand-made work, which GTM Intelligence service it is built to speed up (03.1–03.4, as that page numbers and names them) and what that service feeds, how the work is done today, and whether it is used on engagements yet.
story: Answers the visitor's last question — “does it matter to my engagement?” — honestly and in one model with /capabilities/gtm-intelligence: every instrument is built to speed up a service that page sells (03.1 signal taxonomy & intent monitoring, 03.2 win/loss, 03.3 resonance telemetry, 03.4 quarterly calibration), the work is done by hand today, and none is used on engagements yet. The line under the ledger says the same in one sentence; the close's onward link takes the reader to that page.

reference.site: Approved Kelwin faq/U (the ledger that opens in place, 01 resting open) and fit/U
reference.borrowed: The approved FAQ's ledger behaviour verbatim: real buttons, one row open at a time, 01 rests open, the + turning to −.
reference.kelwin: A table, not a Q&A: a mono column head, a stage column carrying the header's board in miniature (four segments lit to the stage reached), and an open state that keeps the table's columns — the text under the name, the spec (To speed up · Feeds · Today · On engagements) under the reading and the stage. “To speed up” prints the service number in mono, as GTM Intelligence does, so the two pages cross-reference at a glance.

motion: entrance: the kit's section head; the column head fades; the rows cascade in closed (80ms apart); at 1.5s row 01 opens once in place (360ms, the kit's ledger transition) — the page's first body moment. Phones: no auto-open.
ambient: none. interaction: click a row to open it (one at a time; click again to close).
on the live site: plays once at 40% visible. Reduced motion: final state (01 open; all closed on phones), no timers.
notes: One model with GTM Intelligence: each instrument names the 03.x service it is built to speed up and what that service feeds, exactly as capability-services/U prints them; Today lines say how the method does it by hand now (no claim that installs have run). Height 1,206px at 1440 with 01 open. The ledger no longer links GTM Intelligence itself: the close's onward link does, once.
